<json>
{
  "states": [
    "Binding Registered",
    "Binding Removed"
  ],
  "transitions": [
    {
      "from": "",
      "event": "REGISTER request with Contact header field and expiration interval > 0",
      "action": "Registrar adds binding to location service; returns 200 OK with Contact list",
      "to": "Binding Registered"
    },
    {
      "from": "Binding Registered",
      "event": "REGISTER request with Contact header field and expiration interval = 0",
      "action": "Registrar removes binding from location service; returns 200 OK with updated Contact list",
      "to": "Binding Removed"
    },
    {
      "from": "Binding Registered",
      "event": "Expiration interval elapses without refresh",
      "action": "Binding expires (soft state)",
      "to": "Binding Removed"
    },
    {
      "from": "Binding Registered",
      "event": "REGISTER request with Contact header field and expiration interval > 0 (refresh)",
      "action": "Registrar updates expiration time; returns 200 OK with Contact list",
      "to": "Binding Registered"
    },
    {
      "from": "",
      "event": "REGISTER request with Contact header field value '*' and Expires: 0",
      "action": "Registrar removes all bindings for address-of-record; returns 200 OK",
      "to": "Binding Removed"
    }
  ]
}
</json>
